title: Suite taxonomy catalogue v1
description: The closed taxonomy a suite is authored under (03.1.4, D-A7 §8.1), as one selection document: which platform runs it, how wide it is, and why it exists. The three lists are closed — a fourth platform or a renamed purpose is a contract change and a migration, never a new string (D4, 00 §7 lower_snake wire values). A request naming a platform and no level takes that platform's default level (web -> e2e, api -> integration, unit -> unit, mobile -> e2e); purpose defaults to regression and platform to web, which is the suite behaviour the product has today. A mobile suite is stored as mobile only when a member's variant names a native mobile platform (android, ios, ipados): a suite whose variants all name a browser engine is device emulation and is stored as web (AC4).

platform.description: What executes the suite: a browser (web), an HTTP surface (api), the unit-test host (unit) or a native device (mobile).

level.description: How much of the system one run covers. The default follows the platform: api -> integration, unit -> unit, web and mobile -> e2e.

purpose.description: Why the suite exists; a release decision reads this to pick the suites that gate a release. Defaults to regression.
